summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of the static KM Nishat 99 landing page at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified page load, document title & OG meta tags, static asset 200s, all Telegram CTAs (href + target), nav & hero scroll-to-section behaviour (with Lenis), FAQ accordion single-collapsible interaction, mobile menu toggle + link scroll + auto-close, stats count-up (when in view), and presence of all required sections/cards. All checks passed with no console errors and no horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390 widths.
critical_code_review_comments: StatsStrip Counter uses framer-motion useInView with once:true — verified to count up correctly to non-zero values (12,500+, 88%, 1:3+, 365) when scrolled into view. No issue.
Nav scroll offset lands ~80px above the section top due to sticky nav; acceptable for smooth scroll UX with Lenis (scrollToId offset). No functional bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site, no backend. All data-testids exist as specified. Stats count-up only triggers when stats-section enters viewport (margin:-60px) — scroll to it before asserting. Lenis smooth scroll requires ~1.5-2s wait after clicking nav links.
